# JMESPath method

This is an n8n-provided method for working with the [JMESPath](../../../data/specific-data-types/jmespath/) library.

Python support

You can use Python in the Code node. It isn't available in expressions.

| Method        | Description                                       | Available in Code node? |
| ------------- | ------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------- |
| `$jmespath()` | Perform a search on a JSON object using JMESPath. |                         |

| Method        | Description                                       |
| ------------- | ------------------------------------------------- |
| `_jmespath()` | Perform a search on a JSON object using JMESPath. |
